newsitem.title: FINLAND: Borealis sees demand good, unclear margins.
newsitem.headline: Borealis sees demand good, unclear margins.

text.p: Borealis, Europe's leading polyolefin plastics producer owned by Finland's Neste and Norway's Statoil, said on Thursday it expected H2 demand to be healthy but saw uncertainty on margins.

"The economic growth rates of the key European economies are expected to support healthy demand for polyolefin plastics also in the second half of 1997," Borealis said in a statement with its H1 results. "However, new supply capacity is coming on stream ... together with the international oil price outlook, this represents some uncertainty for the further development in Borealis' product margins."

"The business focus for the second half of the year remains on further improvements in business processes and cost effectiveness in Europe, and on building a stronger position towards the Asian markets, Borealis said.
Since May, the company has announced three capacity increase investment projects, in Finland, Sweden and Belgium.
